thread:
Maya: Quick heads-up — I opened a tiny PR to clarify the auth flow and callback examples in the Quickstart hello app. Mostly wording + a small serverless handler snippet. Link in the next message, please take a quick look before I merge.
Docs Bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 — CI triggered (unit + snippet lint).
Oliver: sending eyes :eyes: — is this just copy or are we changing the code examples too?
Maya: Both. The code examples are the same logic but I rewrote the wording around token rotation and callback URI so it reads clearer for serverless users. Also added a short cURL fallback.
Jun: FYI the current callback example might confuse folks using Vercel/Netlify re: CORS + redirect. Can we add a note about setting the redirect URI and a small handler like: ```js
// minimal express-style handler for auth callback
app.get('/auth/callback', (req, res) => {
  const code = req.query.code;
  // exchange code for token with server-side secret
  // store token server-side and redirect to app
  res.redirect('/app');
});
```
Leo: Nice — also add a tiny snippet showing how to include the Bearer header when calling the API: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`
Maya: Good catches. I added both snippets and a one-line note about setting the redirect URI in the OAuth provider console.
Docs Bot: CI ran, lint reported a broken image link in quickstart/auth.md (img 404).
Maya: Ah — the image path changed after the assets reorg last week. I'll update the path and push.
Oliver: I can review the copy this afternoon. Quick ask: can we keep the explanation of "credential shim" lighter — some readers get nervous about any non-first-party term. Maybe "server-side token exchange" instead?
Maya: Yep, will swap phrasing to "server-side token exchange (recommended)" and remove the shim jargon.
Jun: I can smoke-test the Vercel demo with the updated handler later and report back.
Leo: Also suggest a one-line migration note for folks moving from SDK v3 -> v5 re: client instantiation. Lots of users copy-paste the old `new ApiClient()` pattern.
Maya: Added a migration subsection with the minimal replace mapping. Kept it short with a link to the full migration guide.
Docs Bot: CI now green for snippets + lint.
Oliver: Reviewed and left two tiny nits inline (comma + path).
Maya: Fixed both, pushed.
Jun: Demo tested on Vercel — handler works, redirect URI doc helped. No CORS surprises.
Leo: LGTM from me too. :thumbsup:
Maya: Thanks all — I'll merge in ~30m unless anyone objects. Planning to cherry-pick into release branch for tomorrow's docs deploy.
Oliver: No objections. :shipit:
